_comment: Hand-checked panel text for famous battles (the Captain's 15 Oct 2026 batch): a one-paragraph summary, the two sides, the result and the source it was taken from. Applied by scripts/dedupe-places.mjs on every run, after the harvest, so the nightly harvest cannot drop it. 'sides' here replaces the auto-enriched Wikidata belligerents. Keyed by event id.

q38789.name: Battle of Stalingrad
q38789.summary: Axis forces fought the Soviet Union for the city of Stalingrad in 1942–43, the deadliest urban battle in history, ending with the destruction of the German 6th Army.

q48314.name: Battle of Waterloo
q48314.summary: On 18 June 1815 near Waterloo, in today's Belgium, Napoleon's French army was defeated by two armies of the Seventh Coalition in his last battle.

q52418.name: Attack on Pearl Harbor
q52418.summary: On 7 December 1941 Japan launched a surprise air attack on the US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, bringing the US into World War II.

q131969.name: Battle of Thermopylae
q131969.summary: In 480 BC a Greek alliance led by Leonidas I of Sparta held the pass at Thermopylae for three days against Xerxes' Persian army.

q486124.name: Battle of Badr
q486124.summary: In March 624 near Badr, in present-day Saudi Arabia, Muhammad's army defeated a larger Quraysh army led by Abu Jahl.
q486124.result: Survival of the Muslims; start of the Muslim–Quraysh War

q83224.name: Battle of Hastings
q83224.summary: On 14 October 1066 near Hastings, William of Normandy's army defeated King Harold Godwinson's English army, beginning the Norman Conquest of England.

q160077.name: Fall of Constantinople
q160077.summary: On 29 May 1453 the Ottoman army of Mehmed II captured Constantinople, capital of the Byzantine Empire, after a 53-day siege.

q171416.name: Battle of Trafalgar
q171416.summary: On 21 October 1805 the Royal Navy defeated a combined French and Spanish fleet off Cape Trafalgar during the War of the Third Coalition.

q31900.name: Battle of Marathon
q31900.summary: In 490 BC, during the first Persian invasion of Greece, Athens, helped by Plataea, defeated a Persian force at Marathon.

q134114.name: Battle of Austerlitz
q134114.summary: On 2 December 1805 near Austerlitz, in today's Czech Republic, Napoleon's Grande Armée defeated a combined Russian and Austrian army.

q130861.name: Battle of Kursk
q130861.summary: In summer 1943 Germany and the Soviet Union fought near Kursk in south-western Russia, the largest battle in the history of warfare.

q16470.name: Normandy landings
q16470.summary: On 6 June 1944, D-Day, Allied forces landed by sea and air in Normandy, the largest seaborne invasion in history.

q154182.name: Battle of Berlin
q154182.summary: In 1945 the Red Army, with Polish forces, fought its way into Berlin in one of the last major offensives of World War II in Europe.

q151860.name: Siege of Leningrad
q151860.summary: From 1941 to 1944 Germany and Finland blockaded Leningrad for 872 days, but never captured the city.
sides: Nazi Germany, Finland and Italian naval support

q165425.name: Battle of Lepanto
q165425.summary: On 7 October 1571 a Holy League fleet led by Spain and Venice heavily defeated the Ottoman fleet in the Gulf of Patras.

q130847.name: Battle of Verdun
q130847.summary: From February to December 1916 French and German armies fought in the hills north of Verdun, the longest battle of the First World War.

q132568.name: Battle of the Somme
q132568.summary: From July to November 1916 British Empire and French armies fought the German Empire on both banks of the River Somme in France.

q173077.name: Battle of Tours
q173077.summary: In October 732 Frankish and Aquitanian forces under Charles Martel defeated an invading Umayyad army under Abd al-Rahman al-Ghafiqi.

q33570.name: Battle of Grunwald
q33570.summary: On 15 July 1410 the allied armies of Poland and Lithuania decisively defeated the Teutonic Order at Grunwald.

q178850.name: Battle of Salamis
q178850.summary: In 480 BC an outnumbered Greek fleet under Themistocles defeated Xerxes' Persian fleet off Salamis.

q178510.name: Battle of Mohács
q178510.summary: On 29 August 1526 near Mohács, the Ottoman army of Suleiman the Magnificent defeated the Hungarian army of King Louis II.

q173034.name: Battle of Midway
q173034.summary: In June 1942 two US carrier groups decisively defeated Japan's Combined Fleet near Midway Atoll in the Pacific.

q179591.name: Battle of Cannae
q179591.summary: On 2 August 216 BC near Cannae in south-east Italy, Hannibal's Carthaginian army surrounded and nearly annihilated a larger Roman army.

q160387.name: Battle of Actium
q160387.summary: On 2 September 31 BC Octavian's fleet under Agrippa defeated the fleets of Mark Antony and Cleopatra near Actium, Greece.

q87779.name: Battle of the Teutoburg Forest
q87779.summary: In September 9 AD a Germanic alliance led by Arminius ambushed and destroyed three Roman legions under Varus, possibly near Kalkriese.

q200855.name: Battle of Vienna
q200855.summary: On 12 September 1683 at Kahlenberg near Vienna, a coalition under King John III Sobieski broke the two-month Ottoman siege of the city.

q151005.name: Battle of Leipzig
q151005.summary: From 16 to 19 October 1813 at Leipzig, the Coalition armies of Austria, Prussia, Sweden and Russia decisively defeated Napoleon's Grande Armée.

q151290.name: Battle of Moscow
q151290.summary: Between October 1941 and January 1942 the Soviet Union stopped Germany's attack on Moscow.

q180182.name: Battle of Iwo Jima
q180182.summary: In February–March 1945 US forces landed on and captured the heavily fortified island of Iwo Jima from the Japanese army.

q488278.name: Battle of Uhud
q488278.summary: In March 625 the Quraysh defeated the early Muslims in a valley near Mount Uhud, north of Medina.
